outputPath.description: The output path of the Forge app files.

interactive.description: Run deployment with or without input prompts.

manifestTransform.description: A JSONata expression that transforms the manifest.yml content before the deployment.

approve.description: List of validation rules to approve, for example the major version upgrade rule.

majorVersion.description: Specify a major version to update. If not set, minor version upgrades apply to the latest major version.
